source.zh: 底色由两层皮肤光谱模型算出，模型按 NIST 人体皮肤反射参考数据（Cooksey 等 2017）拟合；各部位的倍数部分由文献的色度数据反推、部分是假设，详见 data/curated/look/skin-colour.json。由 tools/look/skin_colour.py 和 skin_regions.py 生成。
source.en: The albedo comes from a two-layer spectral skin model fitted to the NIST reference data set of human skin reflectance (Cooksey et al. 2017); the region multipliers are partly inverted from published colorimetry and partly assumed, see data/curated/look/skin-colour.json. Built by tools/look/skin_colour.py and skin_regions.py.
